title: What actually went right last week
zoomOut: Zoom out: in 1990 the ozone hole was growing every year. It is now the smallest since records began.

quote.text: The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.

slides.summary: A farmer turned 70 acres of his Oregon barley farm into a wetland, and 200 bird species came back.
slides.proves: Farmland can be given back to nature by one person deciding to do it.

slides.summary: Britain's smallest wild pig is back: a breeding programme has taken the pygmy hog from six known animals to 194.
slides.proves: A species written off in the 1990s can be rebuilt when someone keeps at it for thirty years.

slides.summary: A single injection cut inherited high cholesterol by 97 percent for 48 weeks in an early trial.
slides.proves: A condition that needed daily pills for life may become a once-a-year appointment.

slides.summary: Norway launched its first orbital rocket from Andoya, the first from mainland Europe.
slides.proves: Space access no longer belongs only to the countries that started early.

slides.summary: A six-year-old in Cologne recognised her family's stolen car in traffic and led police to it.
slides.proves: Paying attention is a skill that does not wait for adulthood.
